The AllTrails app is a fantastic tool for outdoor enthusiasts. It offers a comprehensive database of hiking, running, and biking trails, making it easy to find the perfect adventure for any skill level. The app provides detailed trail maps, including elevation gain, difficulty level, and user reviews, helping users plan their outdoor activities with confidence.

One of the standout features of the AllTrails app is its offline map capability. This means that even if you're in an area with no cell service, you can still access trail maps and navigate through your chosen route. This is especially useful for remote wilderness areas or when traveling to unfamiliar locations.

The app also allows users to track their progress and record their hikes, runs, or bike rides. This

I’m not a big app reviewer but when it comes to my experience with Day One, I felt completely compelled to share the impact it has made on my life. 

When I left home to live across the country from the only life I knew, I wanted a companion in which to document every step of that journey to remember it by and relish the memories I documented for the rest of my life. 

I stumbled across Day One and quickly started to realize the magic behind it. Every day I started adding photos, jotting down everything in which to remember my journey, all with time stamps, geolocation, and more all at my fingertips.  

As my life shifted and changed, it’s companionship grew with me.

I have tried to have a journal many times throughout my life and the one reason I kept failing at it was because it wasn’t fun. I also didn’t like that if by chance the could read my handwriting they would be totally invading my privacy because anyone can open a notebook if they find it under your mattress. I also couldn’t add photos to it unless I printed them out and tapped them in. And my biggest problem of all was how tired my hand would get writing and how long it took (I have a lot to say). This app has solved all those issues! Typing everything insures that it is legible, the passcode options keeps it safe and private while the sync option ensures everything

I used Day one for years as my go-to journaling app.  It had a great feature set, was easy to use and secure.  I got out of the writing habit a while back and the app was lost when I did an iPad refresh.  
When I reinstalled the app now and started the process of restarting my diary habit, I discovered that the app I so enjoyed using has become what used to be called shareware.  

Only the most basic functions are free, and if you want anything more, they insist that you subscribe to the software as a service.  There is no option of simply hiding all of the “premium” features and I constantly stumble across them, repeatedly seeing the same ad pushing me to pay them a yearly fee to “unlock” all the features that used to be included.

Great idea. Poor execution.
Some major flaws of this app. It requires cellular or WiFi connection. Most hikes I have done do not have cell coverage. Another major flaw, when following directions on how to get to a hike, after arrival it completely dismisses the hike you are planning to do. You need to open the app again and look for your hike again. Another flaw, while recording, if you stop to take pictures or for whatever reason, it stops recording!!! This has happened to me many times and it happened again at today’s hike. Lost my trail. I had to open the app again and look where I was on the trail layers. It was as if you were dropped in a trail 3/4 of the way, but had no recollection of what you have already done. I’m AllTrails Pro subscriber. Deeply regretted.

定位变差了
大概2023年开始用，觉得记录足迹很有意义，用了不久之后也开了会员，使用期间更新频次对于一个纯功能app来说算是频繁的了，特别是了解到开发者还是个人投入之后觉得很棒。但是每次更新并不觉得哪有使用上优化了，反而最重要的定位功能越来越不准确了，几乎每天的轨迹都会发生漂移，并且是在开了正常模式下，不是省电模式。不知道是不是开发者对于app的功能定位发生变化了。个人体感一款定位不准确的轨迹记录app不能再满足我的需求了，倒不如运动手表好用。决定在订阅到期后卸载了，最后希望这款app没有泄漏个人信息的隐患。

不好的体验
很早就在用一生足迹，这款灵敢足迹整套核心逻辑完全照搬前者：自动轨迹记录、点亮城市、轨迹壁纸、行程统计，连宣传话术都高度雷同。
一生足迹是多年前个人开发者原创的单机轨迹工具，这款晚出多年，只在原版基础上加了社交、迷雾地图，核心创意毫无原创性，属于跟风复刻。
同类工具明明可以做差异化设计，直接照搬成熟产品的核心玩法，缺少自己的产品思考，体验没有超越原作，诚意很低，不推荐追求原创设计的用户下载。
